recipes.title: Meat Sauce pasta
recipes.blurb: Slow-simmered beef and sausage ragù with caramelized onions and a Greek yogurt finish
ingredients: 2 jar jarred pasta sauce (marinara, arrabbiata, or basil garlic)
1 tablespoons fresh oregano, chopped (or 1 tsp dried)
steps: Brown the meats: Heat a large heavy-bottomed pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add 1 pounds ground beef and 1 pounds Italian sausage and brown together, press it down initially so it develops a crust, then break it up as it cooks, until no pink remains (about 15 minutes).Once browned, remove the sausage and beef into a bowl and set aside.

Sauté onions: Add 2 medium onions, diced to the pot. Stir to coat with the fond and let the onions soak it all up. Sauté for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft and beginning to caramelize. If the pan dries out too much, add 0.5 cups chicken stock to keep things moist. Also now's the time to add in all the spices you set aside for this dish.
Add garlic: Add 4 garlic cloves, minced and cook, stirring, until fragrant (about 1 minute).

Return sausage and beef and simmer: Return the sausage/beef to the pot with the onions, and garlic. Cook for a few minutes to warm through, then add 2 jar jarred pasta sauces (marinara, arrabbiata, or basil garlic). Stir well to combine.
Slow simmer: Reduce heat to low and let the sauce simmer gently for about 45 minutes, stirring occasionally. Longer simmer builds deeper flavor.
Cook pasta: While the sauce simmers, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook 1 package pasta (any shape except orzo) according to package directions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
Finish with yogurt: Stir 1 cups Greek yogurt into the sauce until fully incorporated and creamy.
Combine and serve: Add the cooked pasta directly to the meat sauce, toss to coat, and serve after its been simmering about 5 minutes. Finish with extra fresh basil and parsley if desired.

recipes.title: Tandoori Butter Chicken
recipes.blurb: Tandoori butter chicken made with thighs and Greek yogurt: smooth, creamy and far less clove-forward than most versions.
ingredients: 3 pounds boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1-inch pieces
steps: Sear the thighs: Season 3 pounds boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1-inch pieces generously with salt and pepper.
Heat 3 tablespoons oil for cooking in a large pan over medium-high heat. Working in batches, sear the chicken 10 minutes per side until golden. Set aside.

Build the base: In the same pan, melt 6 tablespoons butter. Add 2 medium onions, diced and cook 6 minutes until soft and caramelizing. Stir in 6 garlic cloves, minced and 2 tablespoons fresh ginger, minced, cooking 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Bloom the spices: Add 3 teaspoons tandoori masala, 2 teaspoons paprika, 1 teaspoons cumin, and 1 teaspoons chili powder to the pan. Stir constantly for 45 seconds to bloom the spices without burning.
Simmer the sauce: Pour in 3 cans tomato sauce (15 oz each). Stir well and bring to a simmer. Let it bubble gently for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally to let flavors develop.
Cook the chicken: Return all 3 pounds boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1-inch pieces to the pan. Simmer gently for 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and tender.
Finish with yogurt: Remove from heat. Stir in 1.8 cups plain Greek yogurt (full fat) gently until combined, don't boil or it'll curdle. Taste and adjust seasoning. Serve over rice or with naan.

recipes.title: Grilled Steaks with Umami Marinade
recipes.blurb: Thick-cut steaks marinated overnight in fish sauce and Worcestershire for deep savoury flavour, then grilled over hardwood charcoal.
ingredients: 3.5 lbs steaks (ribeye or NY strip, 1.5 inches thick)
1 tablespoons tbsp steak seasoning (or Montreal steak seasoning)
steps: Prepare the marinade: In a bowl, whisk together 5 tablespoons tbsp olive oil, 2 tablespoons tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1 teaspoons tsp fish sauce, 1 tablespoons tbsp steak seasoning (or Montreal steak seasoning), 0.8 teaspoons tsp garlic powder, 0.8 teaspoons tsp onion powder, 1 teaspoons tsp salt, and 0.5 teaspoons tsp black pepper. Place 3.5 lbs steaks (ribeye or NY strip, 1.5 inches thick) in a large baking dish or resealable bag and pour the marinade over, coating all sides evenly. Cover and marinate in the fridge for at least 8 hours, preferably overnight.

Prep the hardwood charcoal: About 30 minutes before grilling, light your charcoal chimney. Let the coals burn until glowing and partially ash-covered. Spread the hardwood charcoal evenly across the grill grate and let the grill heat up, aim for a very hot surface.

Let steaks rest at room temp: Remove the 3.5 lbs steaks (ribeye or NY strip or sirloin, 1.5 inches thick) from the fridge about 15 minutes before grilling so they come closer to room temperature. This ensures more even cooking.
First side: Place the steaks directly on the hot grate. Don't move them for the first 4 minutes this builds a good crust. Close the cover.

Second side: Flip the steaks and grill for another 4 minutes on the second side with the cover closed. For medium-well, aim for an internal temperature of 160°F (check with a meat thermometer at the center). The steaks should have a dark, caramelized crust.
Rest and serve: Transfer to a cutting board and let rest for 5 minutes before serving. This allows the juices to redistribute.
(I recommend some frozen curly fries air fried as a side)

recipes.title: Grilled Chicken Thighs
recipes.blurb: Boneless chicken thighs marinated overnight and grilled over hardwood charcoal until smoky, juicy and charred at the edges.
ingredients: 3 tablespoons tbsp rib rack chicken rub
2 teaspoons tsp Slap Ya Mama Chicka Licka Bam Bam seasoning
1 tablespoons tbsp salt and black pepper
steps: Marinate the chicken: In a large bowl, combine 7 boneless skinless chicken thighs with 3 tablespoons tbsp rib rack chicken rub, 1 tablespoons tbsp onion powder, 1 tablespoons tbsp garlic powder, 4 tablespoons tbsp olive oil, 2 tablespoons tbsp fresh lemon juice, and 2 teaspoons tsp Slap Ya Mama Chicka Licka Bam Bam seasoning. Toss to coat evenly. Cover and marinate in the fridge for at least 8 hours, preferably overnight.

Prep the hardwood charcoal: About 30 minutes before grilling, light your charcoal using a chimney starter. Let it burn until the coals are glowing and partially ash-covered. Spread the hardwood charcoal across the grill grate.

Place chicken on grill: Once the grill is hot and smoking slightly, place the marinated 7 boneless skinless chicken thighs directly on the grate. Don't wipe off the marinade—it adds flavor and moisture. Close the cover.
First side: Grill for 5 minutes on the first side with the cover closed. Open the cover and flip the thighs. Close the cover again.

Second side: Grill for another 5 minutes on the second side. The chicken is done when the internal temperature reaches 170°F at the thickest part (use a meat thermometer). The skin should be lightly charred and crispy.
Rest and serve: Transfer to a plate and let rest for 3 minutes.
Serve hot with your favorite sides.

recipes.title: Grilled burgers
recipes.blurb: Thick charcoal-grilled burgers with a crust from the hardwood fire, seasoned simply and cooked on a hot grate. Ready in about half an hour.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tbsp butter (for toasting buns, optional)
steps: Prep the charcoal: Preheat a chimney full of charcoal until it's glowing and fully lit (about 20 minutes ). Spread the hot coals evenly across the grill grate and let the grill reach high heat.

Form the patties: In a large bowl, combine 1.5 lbs ground beef (80/20 blend) with 1.5 teaspoons tsp salt, 1 teaspoons tsp black pepper, 0.8 teaspoons tsp garlic powder, and 0.8 teaspoons tsp onion powder. Mix gently with your hands until just combined, don't overwork the meat or the burgers will be tough. Form into 4 patties of about 1/3 lb each. Make a slight indent in the center of each patty with your thumb. Or just buy pre-formed patties.
Place burgers on grill: Once the grill is sizzling hot, place the burgers directly on the grate. Close the cover.

Flip frequently: After 5 minutes, open the cover and flip the burgers. Close the cover again. Continue flipping every 1-2 minutes to build an even crust and prevent burning. This frequent flipping keeps the interior juicy while developing a good char.

Cook to desired doneness: Cook until the internal temperature reaches 160°F for well-done or 155°F for medium (about 6-8 minutes total, depending on thickness and heat). A meat thermometer is your best friend here.
Toast buns (optional): Optional: Toast the 4 burger buns cut-side down on the grill for 1-2 minutes while the burgers finish cooking.
Rest and serve: Remove burgers and let rest for 1-2 minutes. Assemble with your favorite toppings and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
recipes.blurb: The classic Southern layered dessert: creamy homemade pudding, ripe bananas and buttery nilla wafers, chilled until the wafers go soft.
ingredients: 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix (3.4 oz, Jell-O brand)
0.5 teaspoons tsp vanilla extract (optional, for deeper flavor)
steps: Make the pudding base: In a large bowl, whisk together 1 can sweetened condensed milk (14 oz) and 1.3 cup ice-cold water until evenly combined. Add 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix (3.4 oz, Jell-O brand) and whisk vigorously until completely smooth with no lumps. Transfer to a medium bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate until the pudding is firm and set, at least 120 minutes or overnight.

Whip the heavy cream: In a separate bowl (or stand mixer), add 3 cups heavy cream, cold. Whip on medium-high speed until stiff peaks form, the cream should hold its shape but still look soft. Be careful not to over-whip; if it looks grainy, you've gone too far.
Fold cream into pudding: Using a whisk, gently fold the whipped cream into the chilled pudding until just combined. A few streaks of cream are fine—don't overmix or you'll deflate the cream.

Layer the pudding: In a large dessert dish or trifle bowl, layer as follows: Start with a layer of 1 box Nilla wafers (11 oz) covering the bottom. Add a layer of sliced 4.5 ripe medium bananas. Spread a layer of the pudding-cream mixture on top. Repeat these three layers until you reach the top of the dish, ending with pudding mixture. You should have roughly 3 layers total.
Chill before serving: Cover the dish and refrigerate for at least 240 minutes, or overnight. This allows the wafers to soften slightly and all the flavors to meld together.
Serve: Serve chilled. If desired, garnish with extra Nilla wafer crumbles or a few banana slices on top before serving. Best enjoyed within 1-2 days of assembly.

recipes.title: Spanish Style Boneless Chicken Thighs with Rice
recipes.blurb: One-pot chicken and rice built on a caramelised onion and garlic paste with paprika and saffron. Everything cooks in the same pan.
ingredients: 2 teaspoons Slap Ya Mama Chicka Licka Bam Bam seasoning
steps: Marinate the chicken: In a large bowl, combine 9 boneless skinless chicken thighs with 3 tablespoons rib rack chicken rub, 3 tablespoons olive oil, 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice, and 2 teaspoons Slap Ya Mama Chicka Licka Bam Bam seasoning. Toss to coat evenly. Cover and marinate in the fridge for at least 4 hours, preferably overnight.
Prep the aromatics: Dice 2 medium yellow onions into medium pieces. Dice 1.5 bell peppers (any color) into medium pieces. Mince 6 garlic cloves, minced and set aside.

Sear the chicken: Heat a large, heavy pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Working in batches if needed, add the marinated chicken (don't pat dry, the moisture helps browning). Sear for 4 minutes per side or until golden brown. Transfer to a plate and set aside.
Start the onion base: In the same pot, add the diced 2 medium yellow onions. Sauté over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until they begin to soften (about 5 minutes).

Add spices to onions: Sprinkle 1.5 teaspoons ground cumin, 1.5 teaspoons smoked paprika, 0.8 teaspoons chili powder, and 1 teaspoons dried oregano over the onions. Stir constantly for about 1 minute until fragrant.

Deglaze and reduce: Add a hefty splash (about ¾ cup) of 5 cups chicken or beef stock to the pot, scraping up any browned bits. Continue cooking, stirring often, until the onions soften and the liquid reduces significantly, you want the onions to break down into a thick paste-like consistency. This takes about 10 minutes.

Add garlic: Add 6 garlic cloves, minced and the diced 1.5 bell peppers (any color). Stir well and cook until the garlic becomes fragrant, about 3 minutes. Continue cooking and stirring, letting the mixture reduce further until it's very thick and mush-like.
Add rice: Add 2.3 cups uncooked long-grain rice to the pot and stir well, coating all the rice with the onion-garlic paste. Let it toast slightly for 2–3 minutes, stirring to avoid sticking.
Build the broth: Add the remaining 5 cups chicken or beef stock (about 4.5–5 cups) to cover the rice by about an inch. Season with 1 pinch salt and black pepper. Stir gently to combine.

Return chicken and cook: Nestle the seared 9 boneless skinless chicken thighs back into the pot among the rice. Bring the liquid to a gentle simmer, then reduce heat to low. Cover with a lid (or foil if you don't have one).

Simmer until done: Cook on low heat for 25–30 minutes, until the rice has absorbed most of the liquid and is tender, and the chicken is cooked through. If the rice still feels undercooked when the broth is mostly gone, add another ½ cup of 5 cups chicken or beef stock, stir gently, cover, and simmer for another 5–10 minutes.
Rest and serve: Remove from heat and let it rest covered for 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork and serve.

recipes.title: Oven-Baked Ribs
recipes.blurb: Fall-off-the-bone baby back ribs from the oven: mustard, a heavy rub, three hours low and slow, then sauced and caramelised.
steps: Remove the membrane: Remove the thin membrane from the back of 2 baby back rib racks by sliding a knife underneath and peeling it off.( I recommend a tissue to grasp the membrane)
Apply mustard: Coat both sides of the ribs generously with 0.5 cups mustard (any kind), working it into all the nooks and crevices.
Apply the rub: Generously coat the ribs with 6 tablespoons Killer Hogs rib rub, covering both sides thoroughly. Pat it in so it adheres to the mustard.
First bake (uncovered): Place the ribs uncovered on a baking sheet or in a baking dish. Place in a 285°F oven for 60 minutes
Second bake (covered with foil): Cover the ribs tightly with foil and return to the 285°F oven for 150 minutes

Apply BBQ sauce: Carefully remove the foil the ribs will be extremely tender. Generously slather 1 cups BBQ sauce (your favorite) all over both sides of the ribs. If you're concerned about them falling apart, you can carefully cut them into individual portions first and sauce each piece.
Final bake (uncovered): Place the sauced ribs back in the oven uncovered at 285°F for 30 more minutes to caramelize the sauce.
Finally if you feel like it slather more BBQ sauce on the ribs before serving, but taste test first to determine if it needs it.

recipes.title: Mac and Cheese (Creamy Smoked Gruyere)
recipes.blurb: Baked mac and cheese built on smoked gruyere, with a sauce that stays creamy instead of grainy and a browned top.
steps: Cook the pasta: Bring a large pot of salted water (1 tablespoon salt (for pasta water)) to a boil. Add 1 pounds elbow pasta and cook until just al dente (a minute or two shy of the box time). Drain and set aside.

Make the roux: In a large saucepan or Dutch oven, melt 6 tablespoons butter over medium heat. Once liquid and foaming, add 0.3 cups all-purpose flour and stir constantly. Cook for 1-2 minutes until it becomes a smooth paste.
Build the sauce: Slowly pour in 1 cups heavy cream and 1 cup of whole milk, stirring continuously to avoid lumps. Let the mixture come to a gentle simmer, stirring occasionally.

Add cheese to sauce: Reduce heat to low. Gradually add 3 cups sharp cheddar/gruyere mixture, shredded (for sauce), stirring gently until fully melted and incorporated. The sauce should be creamy and glossy.
Season the sauce: Stir in 1 teaspoons paprika, 1 teaspoons salt, 1 teaspoons black pepper, 0.1 teaspoons ground mustard seed powder, and 0.3 teaspoons nutmeg. Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
First pasta layer: Spread a thin layer of cooked pasta on the bottom of a greased 9x13 baking dish.

First sauce and cheese layer: Pour a portion of the cheese sauce over the pasta, then sprinkle with a mix of 1.5 cups sharp cheddar, shredded (for layering) and 1.5 cups smoked gruyere, shredded (for layering).
Second layer: Repeat: pasta, sauce, cheese. Layer 2 is done.
Third layer: Repeat one more time: pasta, sauce, cheese. Layer 3 is done.
Bake covered: Cover the baking dish with foil and bake at 375°F for 15 minutes
Bake uncovered: Remove the foil and bake uncovered for 7 more minutes until the top is lightly golden.

recipes.title: Creamy Mustard Mushroom Chicken Thighs with Potatoes
recipes.blurb: One-pan chicken thighs with mushrooms, mustard and cream, baked with potatoes that soak up the sauce. Good for batch cooking.
ingredients: 1 dash of chicka licka bam bam seasoning
4 tablespoons Kerrygold garlic and herb butter
steps: 1. Marinate the chicken overnight: Combine 0.35 cups chicken rub(rib rack), 1 cups olive oil, 0.3 cups lemon juice, 1 dash of chicka licka bam bam seasoning, 1 tablespoons garlic powder, and 1 tablespoons onion powder in a large zip lock bag. Add 4.5 pounds chicken thighs, coat thoroughly, cover, and refrigerate overnight (or at least 8 hours).

2. Brown the chicken: Preheat oven to 375°F. Remove chicken from marinade and pat dry. In a large skillet over medium-high heat, brown the chicken in batches, about 10 minutes per side. Don't crowd the pan.

3. Assemble the baking dish: Arrange browned chicken in a 9x13 baking dish. Add 4 pounds potatoes, quartered and peeled (for 9x13 pan) (quartered potatoes) around and between the chicken pieces to fill the pan. Set aside.
4. Deglaze the pan: In the same skillet (with all those browned bits), deglaze with 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar (for deglazing). Scrape up the fond and let it reduce for about 1 minute.
5. Sauté the onion: Add 1 large white onion, diced (diced white onion) and sauté over medium heat for about 4 minutes until softened.
6. Add the garlic: Add 4 garlic cloves, minced (minced garlic) and cook for about 1 minute until fragrant.

7. Cook down the mushrooms: Pour in a hefty splash of 1/2 cups chicken stock ( 3 divided) (start with about 1/2 cup), let it simmer briefly, then add 2 cups bella mushrooms, sliced (mushrooms). Let them cook down for about 7 minutes.

8. Build the mustard sauce: Whisk in 4 tablespoons spicy brown mustard (spicy brown mustard) until smooth. Add another 1 cup chicken stock (divided) and stir in 4 tablespoons Kerrygold garlic and herb butter
9. Final stock adjustment: Add the final 1 cup chicken stock ( 3 divided) (remaining 1/2 to 1 cup, depending on how saucy you want it). Taste and adjust seasoning. Simmer for 3 minutes
10. Finish with cream: Remove from heat. Stir in 0.5 cups heavy cream (heavy cream) gently. Taste and adjust. If using, stir in 0.3 cups Parmesan cheese (optional) (Parmesan).

11. Bake and finish: Pour the entire sauce over the chicken and potatoes in the baking dish. Cover with foil and bake at 375°F for 45 minutes until potatoes are fork-tender and chicken is heated through.
12. Rest and serve: Remove foil, let rest 5 minutes, and serve straight from the baking dish.
(you'll have about 4.5 pounds of chicken, i usually cook about 3 pounds for my dish and grill the rest of the chicken)
